meta.title: Denver/Arvada Toddler Outing Spots
meta.notes: Why-notes paraphrased/quoted from source captions and newsletters. Drive times are rough estimates from Arvada 80004; verify in Google Maps before leaving. Instagram/Facebook posts change often — re-scrub and update this JSON.

places.name: CSU Spur
places.why: Completely free and open to the public — mock vet clinic, play kitchen, water table, and hands-on spots across three buildings; feels like a children's museum without the price. Open Mon–Fri 9–5 and every 2nd Saturday 10–2 with extra activities.
places.hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm; 2nd Saturdays 10am–2pm; closed other Sat & Sun
places.toddler_notes: Great for ~20 months: indoor play kitchen, water table, mock vet. Free year-round (except Stock Show grounds fee).
places.drive_note: ~22 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6 mi straight-line)

places.name: Belleview Park (Farm & Train)
places.why: Free park with playgrounds and creek; seasonal petting farm and miniature train (~$3 ages 2+, under 2 free) — a classic toddler outing highlighted by Colorado Kids Explore.
source_accounts: Facebook: Colorado Kids Explore - Adventure Guide
places.hours: Park: dawn–dusk. Farm & Train: typically Memorial Day weekend–Labor Day (check city site; 2026 season noted ~9am–3:30pm)
places.toddler_notes: Under-2 free for farm/train. Park playground usable year-round even when farm is closed.
places.drive_note: ~47 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~13 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Apex Center (Indoor Playground)
places.why: Days.in.denver: 'basically an entire day under one roof' — indoor water park, ice rinks, climbing wall, and a FREE indoor playground for little kids (Colorado-themed with a dedicated tots area for ages ~1–3).
places.hours: Open daily; check Apex schedule for playground/pool hours
places.cost: Daily admission typically ~$10.50 kids / $12.50 adults (playground included; verify current rates)
places.toddler_notes: Tots section with small spinners/musical boards — ideal for ~20 months. Right in Arvada.
places.drive_note: ~14 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4 mi straight-line)

places.name: Cheyenne-Arapaho (Tsistsistas-Hinono'ei) Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Natural-themed playground (bison climber, leaf playhouse, sand play, baby swings) geared toward younger kids (~2–8) plus dog park.
places.toddler_notes: Baby swings and sand play; some structures better for slightly older toddlers — supervise closely.
places.drive_note: ~49 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~13 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Bates-Logan Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Inclusive play, hillside slides, separate younger-kid structure, bike/strider loops — all-ages gem in Englewood.
places.toddler_notes: Younger kids area + inclusive features; bring a strider if toddler is ready.
places.drive_note: ~40 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~11 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Washington Park
places.address: South Downing St & E Louisiana Ave area, Denver, CO 80210
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Classic Denver park with playgrounds, lakes, paths — easy picnic + play outing for toddlers.
places.toddler_notes: Multiple playground areas; spacious for stroller walks around the lakes.
places.drive_note: ~33 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~9 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: City View Park
places.address: Welby / North Metro (City View Park), Adams County, CO
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Neighborhood park with multi-level play, rubber/wood-chip surfacing, and a quieter setting.
places.toddler_notes: Quieter option north of Denver; verify playground condition on arrival.
places.drive_note: ~26 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~7 mi straight-line)

places.name: La Raza Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Highland-area park with playground upgrades (revitalized play, picnic, paths) — solid toddler stop near N Denver.
places.toddler_notes: Playground after city improvements; good Highland/Sloan’s Lake corridor pairing.
places.drive_note: ~17 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~5 mi straight-line)

places.name: Paco Sanchez Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Huge radio/music-themed adventure playground (giant mic, nets, spiral slide, zipline) — destination playground often called one of Denver’s best.
places.toddler_notes: Park is HUGE — easy to lose sight of a toddler; go early, stay in toddler-friendly zones, bring a second adult if possible.
places.drive_note: ~19 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~5 mi straight-line)

places.name: Joseph P. Martinez Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. West Denver park with cultural playground / Phase 1 improvements (play, plaza, lawn) — neighborhood outing.
places.toddler_notes: Improvements phased — check what’s open; pair with nearby Sloan’s Lake / Paco Sanchez corridor.
places.drive_note: ~19 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~5 mi straight-line)

places.name: Sloan's Lake Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Lake + skyline views, paths, playgrounds — peaceful picnic/stroller loop with room to toddle.
places.toddler_notes: Watch water edges; playgrounds + open lawn good for ~20 months.
places.drive_note: ~15 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4 mi straight-line)

places.name: Central Park (playground)
places.address: Central Park neighborhood / near E Smith Rd, Denver, CO 80238
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Refurbished playground with toddler structure (musical elements, hot-wheels track), splash/water play in summer, slides, inclusive merry-go-round.
places.toddler_notes: Dedicated 2–5 play structure; summer water features are a hit.
places.drive_note: ~39 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Wright Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Recently renovated (2026 reopen): nature-based play, loop trail, shade, open lawn, dog park — kid-driven redesign.
places.toddler_notes: Nature play + open lawn; freshly renovated as of mid-2026.
places.drive_note: ~23 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6 mi straight-line)
